items.summaryEn: This year, the volume of exports exceeded last year's record by just the cumulative amount until October. With this flow, annual exports are likely to approach $2 billion for the first time. According to the Korean Agricultural Products and Food Transport Corporation (aT) on 22 October, exports amounted to $1585.1 million (about $219.1 billion) between January and October of this year. This is a 26.3% increase over the same period last year, and last year's annual export volume was 1.5 billion.
